heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly to partly sunny. Highs from the upper 40s to mid 50s north, and mid 50s to around 60 in the south. North to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Increasing clouds. Showers likely west of the Greens, mainly after midnight; chance late east of Greens. Lows from the upper 30s to mid 40s, except low to mid 30s northeast. Winds becoming east to southeast a 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly cloudy with showers likely; a thunderstorm possible south. Highs in the low to mid 60s in the south, and mid 50s to lower 60s north, with some lower 50s far north. South to southeast winds 10 to 20 mph and gusting to 30 mph, except gusting to 40 mph in the Champlain Valley, and along the northern slopes of the Greens.
